root_cause: The generated simple-output entry table routes unprefixed C4/C5 into the verified VEX register writer only in 64-bit mode. The 32-bit AVX2 panel therefore pays full decode/translation/printing even for the same ordinary register plans.
canonical_boundary: Admit only register ModR/M, VEX2 with disambiguating high bits, and VEX3 W=0 with no register extensions and vvvv in 0..7. Reuse existing validated register rows, then project the canonical 32-bit rex=0 and addr_size=4 fields. LDS/LES, memory and all other encodings retain fallback.
coverage_limit: 3081 is the observed upper bound for all remaining VEX register forms, not a claim that every form is admitted by this prototype.
